div.div: صَبَارَّةٌ , [respecting the form of which see حَمَارَّةٌ,] (S, M, K,) and ↓ صَبَارَةٌ , without teshdeed, (Lh, M, K,) and ↓ صَبْرَةٌ , (K,) The intenseness of the cold (S, M, K) of winter: (S, M:) and [in an absolute sense] intenseness of cold: (TA:) and ↓ صَبْرَةٌ signifies also the middle of winter; (K;) and so ↓ صَوْبَرَةٌ . (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
